name: Yagisaki Emiri
source:
She excels academically and is beautiful, but is generally unsociable.
Maybe because she has a daddy complex, she secretly resents her new mom.
She’s always looking down on the protagonist, too—a sarcastic type who speaks in a cool, detached tone. A secret sadist.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro-touch/work/=/product_id/VJ006438.html] DLsite[/url]]
